title: Toward an Ethics of AI Belief

bias_targets.methodology: Philosophical analysis of predictive profiling and doxastic wronging, using the racially disparate risk scores of the COMPAS recidivism algorithm as a theoretical case study.

Theoretical evaluation of epistemic and ethical decolonization, examining the dominance of English-language training data and Western ethical frameworks in the development of Large Language Models (LLMs).

Conceptual analysis of epistemic behaviors and morally owed beliefs, referencing protected characteristics in medical algorithms and applying feminist epistemology (e.g., the #BelieveWomen movement) to AI doxastic states.
